thread:
Nina: Following up from the postmortem — collecting owners for the cross-region routing + LB/DNS retry pattern. Please ack and add ETA.

Carlos: Ack. I'll own the routing failover tuning. Plan: reduce cross-region retry window and add sticky route weight decay. ETA: config PR by Mon.

Rohit: I will run targeted e2e tests and validate TLS handshakes against older pods. Need Carlos' config PR to start tests. ETA: test plan Wed morning.

IncidentBot: Incident 2025-11-08 closed. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/cross-region-retry-patterns-2025 (auto-attached)

Ivy: From logs, we saw a recurring DNS TTL skew that caused transient bad routing for 30-60s during failover. Recommend adding a TTL alignment check in the LB control loop. I'll own telemetry. ETA: telemetry + dashboard tile by Thu.

Gabe: I'll draft an on-call playbook snippet for where to look when TLS retries spike and include the KV cache sanity checks. ETA: Fri.

Aria: Customer impact: two Dedicated customers saw elevated errors. I'll reach out to account leads with a template note. ETA: outreach today.

Carlos: Draft routing snippet pushed:
```yaml
failover_policy:
  cross_region:
    retry_limit: 1
    window_ms: 300
    sticky_decay_seconds: 600
  prefer_local: true
```
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2401

Rohit: Starting canary with 5% to region-c. Early metrics show retry_count down 40%, small TLS SNI spike (0.15%). Will monitor for 2h.

Nina: Action list recap:
- Carlos: routing failover config PR (ETA Mon)
- Rohit: canary + e2e tests (ETA Wed)
- Ivy: telemetry & dashboard for DNS TTL skew (ETA Thu)
- Gabe: on-call playbook (ETA Fri)
- Aria: customer comms (ETA today)

Ivy: Datadog metric I will add:
```
sum:network.dns.ttl_skew{env:prod}.rollup(max,60)
```
Alert: if ttl_skew > 20s in >3 nodes for 5m.

Gabe: Playbook notes: check LB healthcheck logs, compare SNI served vs expected, run `curl --resolve` test against affected VIPs.

Aria: Outreach sent to account leads for cust-alpha and cust-gamma. Will share templates.

Carlos: PR merged, healthcheck tweak added to prefer SNI verification early. Rolling to prod now. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2410

Rohit: Canary finished, 0 incidents during 4h. Post-roll metrics: TLS handshake failure rate down to 0.08%. Closing my testing tasks.

Nina: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem remediation tracker with owners and mark ETAs. Please paste final alert IDs and playbook link here when ready.
